usage: 綠茶 usually functions as a noun, referring to a type of tea made from unoxidized leaves.
It is commonly used in daily conversations to talk about a popular beverage choice.
綠茶 can be paired with food discussions, especially dim sum and other light meals.
In questions and requests, 綠茶 often appears when ordering drinks at restaurants or tea houses.
You can use 綠茶 when comparing different tea types or recommending a healthy drink.
